proposals.title: Generalize Proactive Lateral Passing Beyond Confined Corridors (Slow Lead-Obstacle Overtaking)
proposals.physical_rationale: In NARROW-GATE post-exit (x > 10.0 m, 15.0 m open width), the robot tailgates DYN-GATE-1 (+0.80 m/s) at 0.83 m/s and ~0.17 m surface clearance because CorridorPassingManager restricts proactive passing to confined walls (min_wall_dist <= 2.0 m). Allowing proactive lateral A* passing whenever a slower obstacle continuously obstructs the path ahead in passable space lets the robot overtake with >= 0.50 m lateral clearance.
proposals.expected_collision_risk_effect: Eliminates post-gate tailgating collisions in L1-RD-01__01 and L1-SG-01__01 without knowing waypoint_b_m.
proposals.potential_effect_on_other_scenarios: Low risk if gated by hysteresis (e.g. >= 5 steps) and full DWA+braking validation; may also help SUDDEN-STOP wide-channel passing.
proposals.safety_margin_implications: Strictly preserves 0.15 m safety margin; only accepts DWA- and braking-validated passing paths.

proposals.title: Causal Velocity-Dependent Following Standoff in DWA Scoring / Clearance
proposals.physical_rationale: DWA currently treats 0.153 m surface clearance behind a +0.80 m/s moving obstacle identically to 0.153 m behind a static wall, allowing 0.83 m/s tailgating with only 0.17 m buffer (~0.10 s reaction time to any deceleration/reversal). Adding a soft velocity-proportional standoff preference (or braking-distance-aware clearance term) encourages DWA to either maintain >= 0.6-1.0 m following distance or steer laterally into open space.
required_observations: Observed obstacle position and causal velocity
proposals.expected_collision_risk_effect: Increases reaction buffer before any unannounced obstacle deceleration or reversal.
proposals.potential_effect_on_other_scenarios: Minimal impact on normal cruising; must be tuned carefully so it does not cause premature slowdowns in CROSSING or MULTIPLE-DYNAMIC-OBSTACLES.
proposals.safety_margin_implications: Does not relax 0.15 m hard threshold; adds soft preference for larger dynamic buffer.

recommended_regression_tests: Minimum new tests: (1) Post-gate open-space overtaking of slower lead obstacle, (2) Causal isolation check ensuring no waypoint_b_m access during post-gate passing.
